description: List the reports the sending service sent for this mailbox, newest first, up to 100 (20 unless you ask). Each says whether it was a bounce or a complaint and what became of it: the recipient was put on the list (suppressed), the send was marked bounced and nobody was put on the list (stamped), no send of this mailbox matched (no_send), it named someone the send didn't go to (other_recipient), or it was a delay (not_final). It never carries the service's words or an address. Kept 30 days.

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 100. Left out, 20.

name: list_mailbox_reports
title: List a mailbox's service reports
